judge: thinking judge with one-sentence reason (run_variants.judge_with_reason), unchanged; the exact verifier only scores
execution: Arms run sequentially in arm_order, each alone on the fleet via inkling/arms.py (fresh admission with the shim sha and mem fraction below, prefix-cache flush, server counters, idle wait, GPU energy). Watchdog inkling/watch.sh; MemAvailable logged every 60 s.
resume_rule: If an arm stops on an infrastructure fault (runner stop flag, worker or judge infra failure, node fault), the fault is fixed and the same arm is continued with arms.py --resume-from (skips its cases that finished without infra faults; reruns the others with the same seeds) and documented as an amendment. Server tokens, wall and energy of an arm are then the sums over its segments (wasted work of the stopped segment included and reported separately). Never a silent restart; no case is dropped.
exclusions: None. All 96 cases of each arm count.

serving.launch: inkling/serve.sh, MEM=0.75 since 2026-11-21 16:25 Europe/Warsaw (KV ~1.08M tokens per node)
serving.adapter: inkling/shim.py (vLLM dialect; client disconnects close the upstream stream and count as shim:client_cancels)

concurrency_note: G: at most 4 agents in flight per case. W: a case that already had a failure may run up to 8 in flight, but only while no case of the arm waits for admission (work-conserving; widened agents and their judges admitted atomically, 2 judge permits reserved, re-check on release or every 2 s). Both: 20 cases at once, per-endpoint cap 20 (agents and judges) <= 25 per node. Each arm runs alone.

wide.trigger: no case waiting for admission; case already had a failure; never time-triggered

generator: make_arithmetic_hard.py --seed 2026112420 --protocol arithmetic-hard-v20 --output datasets/arithmetic-hard-v20 (after this plan is committed and pushed); same rules as hard-v5..v19
question: Generic efficiency (owner rule): Fable round 4 idea 1. Replay estimate: arm wall -9 to -13 %, GPU Wh -7 to -10 % at equal tokens. Energy follows wall time, not tokens (GPU power is nearly flat in load). G = roll12cancel (default), W = roll12wide.
pairing: Same tasks, seeds, agent base seeds (1000*seed + 20400 + slot), initial node placement and judge base seeds; agents differ only in when they start.

primary_outcomes.efficiency: Arm wall and GPU Wh (per solved case).
primary_outcomes.accuracy: Solved and wrong per arm; paired exact sign test.
primary_outcomes.mechanism: Max width reached per case and when.

decision_rule: W (roll12wide) replaces G (roll12cancel) as the arithmetic default if W has 0 wrong, W solved >= G solved - 2 (noise band), and W arm wall <= 0.95 x G arm wall (exact, from UTC timestamps).
baseline_note: Defaults: arithmetic roll12cancel (generic, no hints); coding R2; worker transport retry and judge retry; roll12relay under test on hard-v19.
